why: Both analyses catch the EPS-doubling goal, EPS-linked pay, thin capital, the duration gap and the self-defined operating earnings, so they are level on the stop-doing list and brutal facts. Analysis 2 edges ahead because its denominator (profit per dollar of mortgage credit risk managed) sits closer to the key's, and its stage-by-stage decline register names accounting discretion, aggressive new credit products and a thin-capital path to takeover.
